text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rhein Kraft is an Umamusume who longs to 
become a "Tiara Umamusume"—those who race 
in pursuit of the tiara's brilliance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As a young girl, she was deeply moved by 
an Oaks Umamusume's run and her words. 
Ever since, she has dreamed of passing the 
baton of her own running to someone else.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tracen Academy is home to senior Tiara 
Umamusume as well. Line Craft would always 
watch their admired backs with sparkling 
eyes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, rivals were plenty. Her peers 
Cesario, Air Messiah, and Daring Heart 
were all aiming for the Tiara route as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before her peers, she declared her 
intention to win the Triple Tiara—the Oka 
Sho, the Yushun Himba (Japanese Oaks), and 
the Shuka Sho.
